items.name: strictConcaveOn_sqrt_mul_log_Ioi
items.type: : StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 1) fun x => √x * Real.log x

items.name: deriv_sqrt_mul_log
items.type: (x : ℝ) : deriv (fun x => √x * Real.log x) x = (2 + Real.log x) / (2 * √x)

items.name: deriv_sqrt_mul_log'
items.type: : (deriv fun x => √x * Real.log x) = fun x => (2 + Real.log x) / (2 * √x)

items.name: deriv2_sqrt_mul_log
items.type: (x : ℝ) : deriv^[2] (fun x => √x * Real.log x) x = -Real.log x / (4 * √x ^ 3)

items.name: hasDerivAt_sqrt_mul_log
items.type: {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : HasDerivAt (fun x => √x * Real.log x) ((2 + Real.log x) / (2 * √x)) x

items.name: Real.log_doublingGamma_eq
items.type: : Set.EqOn (Real.log ∘ Real.doublingGamma) (fun s => Real.log (Real.Gamma (s / 2)) + Real.log (Real.Gamma (s / 2 + 1 / 2)) + s * Real.log 2 - Real.log (2 * √Real.pi)) (Set.Ioi 0)
